hero.label: General Secretariat
hero.title: University Degrees
hero.description: Information about official degrees issued by UNC

c1.label: Processing time
c1.note: The timeframe may vary depending on the time of year and administrative workload.

c2.label: Document requirements
c2.note: Birth certificate, valid national ID, academic documentation and proof of payment.

c3.label: Current fee
c3.note: Amounts are updated periodically. Always check the current rate.

graduates.label: For graduates
graduates.title: Degree application
graduates.description: Steps to apply for your graduation diploma once all academic requirements have been met.

s1.title: Verify academic requirements
s1.description: Ensure you have completed all courses, practical work and the final project required by your degree program.

s2.title: Submit formal application
s2.description: Complete the degree application form at the General Academic Directorate and attach the required documentation.

s3.title: Pay processing fee
s3.description: Make the payment of the applicable fee according to the current schedule. Check the updated amount at the office.

s4.title: Collect your degree certificate
s4.description: Once your application has been processed, you will receive a notification to collect your diploma at the General Secretariat.

recognition.label: Special procedure
recognition.title: Degree recognition
recognition.body1: The recognition of degrees issued by foreign universities, or the validation of UNC degrees before national and international bodies, is processed through the General Academic Directorate in coordination with the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Paraguay.
recognition.body2: To initiate this process, applicants must submit the original documentation duly apostilled or legalized as appropriate, along with an official Spanish translation when documents are in another language.
